request.head: ultra/1b3276062063-towerops-plan-compare
request.title: Compare saved policy experiments without replanning
request.body:
## Compare saved policy experiments

The native world planner already retains every individually screened alternative, but its saved reports have no comparison consumer. The active-world browser and fixed-scenario replay cover different workflows. This adds `python3 compare_plans.py LEFT.json RIGHT.json [--json]` for two saved `towerops.world-plan.v1` outputs of the same exact native world and review clock.

The consumer displays complete saved policy context, full source/body hashes, retained and one-sided advisory identities, and their original menu ranks. It refuses incompatible worlds/clocks and malformed, incomplete or internally inconsistent reports before output. Integer/float, signed-zero, literal text and exact advisory identity are preserved. It reads direct regular files only and never runs planning, chooses a preferred policy, approves or applies a proposal.

### Scope and source

Closes #56. Four product paths: new `compare_plans.py`, `tests/test_compare_plans.py`, `COMPARE_PLANS.md`, and four additive README lines. No planner, safety/admission, audit, TypeScript, UI, CSV #52, Undo #51, radar #59, dependency or workflow changes.

Exact head `1a71f19dfbc1eb89c05baecd2e2f49bc6e6e0613`, tree `6735fb90acd7286acbf4ec5270ed4bb623ba68a6`, parent `c9547893ee4a9f4cdfc64dfe555f8f313ba8237a`. All461 unrelated parent blobs/modes are preserved; the native producer dependencies are byte-identical to the original5b301 source. [Source and qualification packet](docs/qualification/plan-comparison-ultra-1b3276062063/README.md).

### Qualification at draft publication

- **Passed:**16 actual Mac Python3.13 API methods against exact native source. A process audit hook forbade filesystem mutation, subprocess and network effects; zero were attempted.
- **Original native controls:**5NM→3NM changes policy but retains all66 saved identities;6NM retains62/removes4;0.1-minute horizon records no conflict/zero alternatives. Original native WorldState/fixed-scenario intake APIs refuse a saved planning report.
- **Pending:**8 authored real CLI/file methods through the existing ordinary hosted Python3.12 pytest/Ruff workflow; independent source/contract review; final integration/receiving.
- **Preserved limitation:**both Mac file-bootstrap attempts stopped before workspace creation, first at shell ENOSPC and then at the unchanged512MiB reserve guard. No Mac file/CLI, installed runtime, browser or Windows-hub receiving is claimed.

This is inspection of recorded results. Body hashes establish internal consistency, not trusted producer provenance, original-input possession, complete menu reproduction, a fresh safety decision or a causal policy-quality conclusion. Menu entries remain alternatives, never a simultaneous batch. Output failure is nonzero and can follow a partial stdout write.

The PR remains draft until the actual hosted native gates and independent review are complete.
